issues.display_title: Issue #591: Add Pano URL and Thumb URL to Tour Panoramas Response
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Add Pano URL and Thumb URL to Tour Panoramas Response

  • Feature Update for: #588
  • Previous Task: Get Tour Panoramas GoThru Integration
  • Previous Implementation: Get Tour Panoramas GoThru Integration Impl
  • Commit: bd7d5cc
  • Endpoint: GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas
  • Provider Endpoint: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/panoramas
  • Reference Spec: GoThru-API-New/docs/v2/tours/management/internal-user-virtual-tours.md#get-internalusersuuidvirtual-tourstour_keypanoramas
  • Date: 2026-10-07

1. Summary

Enhanced the GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas endpoint originally introduced in issue #588. The response now includes pano_url (full equirectangular panorama image URL) and thumb_url (optimized 350x175 thumbnail URL) for every panorama item returned. The parser accommodates both snake_case and camelCase field variations from the GoThru APIL provider and safely falls back to empty strings when omitted.

2. Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:

    • Updated CleanTourPanorama model to include PanoURL and ThumbURL: 
      type CleanTourPanorama struct {
    ID       int      `json:"id"`
    Sequence int      `json:"sequence"`
    Name     string   `json:"name"`
    Lat      *float64 `json:"lat"`
    Lng      *float64 `json:"lng"`
    Altitude float64  `json:"altitude"`
    PanoURL  string   `json:"pano_url"`
    ThumbURL string   `json:"thumb_url"`
}

  2. src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas.go:

    • Updated transformTourPanoramas(raw []map[string]interface{}) []Models.CleanTourPanorama to parse pano_url (with fallback to panoUrl) and thumb_url (with fallback to thumbUrl): 
      panoURL := toString(p["pano_url"])
if panoURL == "" {
    panoURL = toString(p["panoUrl"])
}

thumbURL := toString(p["thumb_url"])
if thumbURL == "" {
    thumbURL = toString(p["thumbUrl"])
}
    • Added PanoURL: panoURL and ThumbURL: thumbURL to the constructed CleanTourPanorama slice element.

  3. src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas_test.go:

    • Updated TestGetTourPanoramas_Success mock payload to test:
      • Panorama 1: Snake_case keys (pano_url, thumb_url).
      • Panorama 2: CamelCase keys (panoUrl, thumbUrl).
      • Panorama 3: Missing/omitted keys resulting in empty string values "".
    • Added assertions to verify pano_url and thumb_url for all three test items.

  4. src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru_test.go:

    • Added TestFetchTourPanoramas_Success unit test.
    • Spins up a mock HTTP server simulating GoThru APIL.
    • Verifies authorization header (Bearer test-service-token), request header (X-Requestor-App: panorra), path (/internal/users/user-uuid-123/virtual-tours/test-tour-key/panoramas), and pagination query parameters (page=1&per_page=20).
    • Asserts unmarshaled provider data contains valid pano_url and thumb_url.

  5. api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Tour Panoramas.yml:

    • Updated Bruno collection example 200 response to include pano_url and thumb_url.

3. Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas

Headers

Header Value Required Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Yes Authenticated user session
Accept application/json Yes MIME type

Path Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
tour_key string Yes The tour key identifier (e.g. u1NXOiVK)

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
page integer No 1 Page number
per_page integer No 20 Records per page (max: 100)

Example Request

  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"

1. Problem

In the initial implementation of the Tour Panoramas endpoint for issue #588, the CleanTourPanorama model provided node sequence, filename, coordinates (lat/lng), and altitude.

However, frontend client applications (Panorra Web, PWA, and Trail Post interactive builders) need to:

  1. Render visual panorama thumbnail previews in lists, node selectors, and timeline waypoints.
  2. Load the high-resolution equirectangular panorama image when viewing or inspecting an individual node in the 360 viewer.

The GoThru provider API (GoThru-API-New) exposes the full panorama image URL (pano_url / panoUrl) and the optimized thumbnail URL (thumb_url / thumbUrl). panorra-api-go must extract, normalize, and expose both fields in the CleanTourPanorama response payload.

2. Scope

  • Models (src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go):
    • Extend CleanTourPanorama struct with:
      • pano_url: string (PanoURL)
      • thumb_url: string (ThumbURL)
  • Action Handler Transformation (src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas.go):
    • In transformTourPanoramas, parse pano_url with fallback to panoUrl (camelCase provider variation).
    • Parse thumb_url with fallback to thumbUrl (camelCase provider variation).
    • Populate PanoURL and ThumbURL on CleanTourPanorama results.
  • Bruno API Collection (api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Tour Panoramas.yml):
    • Update response examples to include pano_url and thumb_url.
  • Unit Tests (src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas_test.go):
    • Update TestGetTourPanoramas_Success to verify:
      • Normalization from snake_case (pano_url, thumb_url).
      • Fallback from camelCase (panoUrl, thumbUrl).
      • Graceful empty string fallback when URLs are omitted.
  • Client Unit Tests (src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru_test.go):
    • Add TestFetchTourPanoramas_Success verifying HTTP request structure, authentication headers, query parameters, and JSON response unmarshaling including pano_url and thumb_url.

3. Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas response includes pano_url and thumb_url for each panorama item.
  • Supports both snake_case (pano_url, thumb_url) and camelCase (panoUrl, thumbUrl) from provider payloads.
  • Absent URLs default to empty string "" without errors or null fields.
  • Bruno API collection reflects updated response schema.
  • All unit tests in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration and src/Utils/GoThru pass cleanly without live network or database access.
